description: One-call snapshot of Voidly's measurement coverage: countries measured, measurement networks, domains measured, category coverage and the freshest measurement time. Confirmed national block counts, the deepest censor and the most-blocked category are under review (the national blocklist layer let false positives through in open countries and is being rebuilt with a stricter rule) and return null, with a review object giving the layer's window end as the data date.
name: get_censorship_summary
